given: an ambulance whose published kit list requires two of a kit definition in one compartment and one of the same definition in a second compartment, and whose daily checklist inspects that definition
a second ambulance whose kit list lists a different definition instead
when: obligations are generated for one due instant, and an inspector records a presence count for the first compartment's line
the inspector later records a presence count for the second compartment's line
then: the first ambulance owes one presence obligation per kit list line, each pinning its own line, both due at the same instant
the first count names its line and satisfies only that line's obligation, even though both lines share the definition's presence item and due instant
a count equal to the line's required count passes; a count above or below it fails and opens a deficiency naming the presence item and that compartment
the contents of every instance of the definition present on the ambulance are owed, wherever it is, and a missing instance owes no contents
the second ambulance owes nothing for the first definition
notes: issue #129 (https://github.com/JustApu/CheckYourAmbulance/issues/129), SPEC amendment 2.0.0. Contract only: kit lists and presence obligations are implemented in later parts of issue #129.
